subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo and align evaluation kickoff scope
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novushealth.com>, Carlos Mendes <carlos.m@novushealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo and align evaluation kickoff scope

Hi Samantha / Carlos —

Thanks again for the conversation today — helpful to understand Novus Health's priorities (faster claims triage, preserving PHI on premise, and reducing average handle time for your specialist review team). Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock in a demo + evaluation kickoff: 

Recap from discovery:
- Primary goal: reduce reviewer time by 25% on high-risk claims workflows
- Data constraints: PII/PHI must remain in-customer VPC for pilot scope; limited export allowed for embeddings
- Success metrics: latency under 300ms 95th pct for interactive workflows; precision/recall targets to be defined by your QA team

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep dive / demo (60m) — show model behavior on representative prompts and discuss on-prem connector.
   - Two slots we have available: Wed Nov 18 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu Nov 19 13:00–14:00 PT.
2) Evaluation kickoff (45–60m) — agree trial timeline, success criteria, and initial prompt set/evals; review security checklist and required artifacts (SOC2 evidence, network diagram).

I've attached a short trial-plan template to help shape the kickoff agenda (trial-plan-template.xlsx). Can you confirm which slot works for your team and whether we should include your technical lead (to cover VPC/KMS/network design)? If you prefer another time, send 2–3 options and we'll accommodate.

Agenda we propose for the kickoff (we can tighten once you confirm participants):
- Introductions + roles (5m)
- Demo: sample flows + prompt behavior (20m)
- Trial plan & success criteria (15m)
- Security & onboarding checklist (10m)
- Next actions & owners (5m)

Attendees from our side: myself (AE), Aditya Rao (Solutions Engineer), Marissa Cole (CSM).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: trial-plan-template.xlsx (spreadsheet, 2 sheets)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novushealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Carlos Mendes <carlos.m@novushealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo and align evaluation kickoff scope

Thanks Kimberly — great summary. Wed Nov 18 10:00 PT works for us.

We'll have Rohit Shah (Lead Architect) join for the network/KMS discussion. I've attached a short participant list with roles so you can tailor the agenda (participant-list.csv).

One quick ask: can Aditya include an example of how you handle on-prem KV caching and the options for quantized models during the demo? Rohit will want to see expected network egress and any components that touch PHI during the trial.

Looking forward to the session — please send the calendar invite and any pre-read.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Dir, Technical Program Management | Novus Health
Samantha.Lee@novushealth.com

- Can Novus drop 4–6 sample prompts into the shared "Prompt set" sheet before EOD Tue so I can prepare examples against your real distributions?
- Rohit: if you have a short network diagram (or a link to reviewed firewall rules), that would be super helpful for the design discussion.
- Also proposing a 30-minute internal pre-call sync with Kimberly + Aditya on Wed Nov 18 at 9:30 PT to align the technical demo flow — Kimberly, I'll leave it to you to send the calendar invite if that works.

I'll plan to surface the options for KV cache placement and a low-egress quantization profile during the demo.
